title: Multiple Windows
description: Links and buttons that open new tabs and popup windows, which tests have to switch to and back from.

new-tab.title: New tab
new-tab.description: A link that opens a page in a new tab.

named.title: Named window
named.description: Both links open in a window with the same name, so the second click reuses the window the first one opened.

popup.title: Popup window
popup.description: Open a popup window, send a message from it back to this page, and see it close.

status.not-opened: The popup has not been opened
status.blocked: The popup was blocked by the browser

new-tab.heading: New tab
new-tab.text: This page opened in a new tab. Switch back to the original window to carry on.

popup.heading: Popup window
popup.text: Send a message to the window that opened this popup. The popup closes once it has sent it.
popup.label: Message
popup.no-opener: This window was not opened from the Multiple Windows scenario, so there is nowhere to send a message.

named-one.text: This is page one of the named window.
